build_processing_graph: build a ProcessingGraph from a specification mapping step names to their input types and dependencies
get_processing_step_by_name: get a ProcessingStep by its name from the processing graph and return a copy
get_children_steps: get the list of child processing steps that are triggered after a given step completes
get_ancestors_steps: get all ancestor processing steps that directly or indirectly trigger a given step
parse_artifact_id: parse an Artifact id string into its dataset, revision, config, split, and processing step name parts
